remarks: Boasting a classic layout, this spacious colonial is located on 2 acres in the sought after Hoyt Farm community. This home has an expansive cathedral ceiling family room with fireplace, formal spaces include formal dining room and living room with fireplace and cozy den which opens to a screened in porch. The eat-in kitchen accesses the deck and backyard. Upstairs are three generous bedrooms and large master suite with walk-in closet. The walk-out lower level can be turned into playroom and exercise area and large three car garage has space for all your equipment. This house is waiting for your personal touch to customize and renovate to fit your personal preference and is being sold in its present condition.
